critical_code_review_comments: VariationOrders.jsx is 869 lines — nearing the 700-line threshold; consider extracting each wizard step into its own component for maintainability (not blocking).

frontend/tests/register-loader.mjs invokes register() with a pathToFileURL(url) second arg that resolves incorrectly under Node 20 --import (results in an ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND with a doubled `file:` prefix). Workaround: run tests with `--loader ./tests/loader.mjs`. Suggest fixing register() call to `register('./loader.mjs', import.meta.url)`.

test_variation_orders.py imports os and calls .rstrip('/') on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — but pytest run outside of Emergent context won't have that env; consider a conftest that loads /app/frontend/.env, matching sibling test files.
